subject: Guardian
text: Guardian has 1489 HP and no elemental weaknesses.

evidence.quote:
BOSS TIME: Guardian
HP: 1489
WEAKNESS: None

subject: Guardian
text: Against Guardian, Aguro and Hero should attack each round, Lufia casts Drain then Bolt, and Jerin uses Power Gourds on physical attackers before healing with the Wind Flute.

evidence.quote: STRATEGY: Aguro and the Hero should attack every round.  During the first round, Lufia should cast Drain, then Bolt in each subsequent round.  Jerin should use Power Gourds on the Aguro and the Hero during her first two rounds, then use the Wind Flute to heal from the Guradian's MT spells.

subject: chest
text: Defeating Guardian yields access to a chest containing the Light Key.

evidence.quote: For defeating him, you get access to the chest which contains the LIGHT KEY.

subject: Linze
text: The recommended level for Linze is 34.

evidence.quote:
LINZE [LINZ1]
Recommended Level: 34

subject: Inn
text: Staying at the inn in Linze costs 75 Gold.

evidence.quote: LINZE [LINZ1] Recommended Level: 34 Treasure: Escape, Ex Magic, Sweet Water, Dragon Egg, Swing Wing Enemies: Crazy Pine (Fire), Land Worm, Mad Lily (Fire), Werewolf =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= Inn - 75

subject: bookshelf
text: Between the equipment shops on the upper plateau, a bookshelf contains an Escape.

evidence.quote: Between the equipment shops to the left, examine the bookshelf which contains an ESCAPE.

subject: basement
text: A hidden Ex Magic can be found in the lower right corner of the basement of Brant's house.

evidence.quote: In the lower right corner, you can find a hidden EX MAGIC.

subject: chest
text: Heading down at the fork in the basement tunnel leads to three chests containing a Sweet Water, Dragon Egg, and Swing Wing.

evidence.quote: At the fork in the hall, go down first to three chests which contain a SWEET WATER, DRAGON EGG, and SWING WING.

subject: chest
text: One of the three chests down from the basement hall fork contains a Dragon Egg.

evidence.quote: At the fork in the hall, go down first to three chests which contain a SWEET WATER, DRAGON EGG, and SWING WING.

subject: chest
text: One of the three chests down from the basement hall fork contains a Swing Wing.

evidence.quote: At the fork in the hall, go down first to three chests which contain a SWEET WATER, DRAGON EGG, and SWING WING.

subject: chests
text: Starting in the lower right corner and moving clockwise on the first plateau yields eight chests containing an Ex Bomb, Revive, Ex Potion, Hi Magic, Stone Cure, Escape, Ex Bomb, and Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Start in the lower right corner and working your way around clockwise while opening the eight chests which contain an EX BOMB, REVIVE, EX POTION, HI MAGIC, STONE CURE, ESCAPE, EX BOMB, and EX POTION.

subject: chest
text: Falling down a pitfall intentionally from above the lower-left chests and climbing the stairs leads to a chest with Alumina.

evidence.quote: From just above the lower left chests, walk straight right to intentionally fall down a pitfall.  Climb the stairs to a chest which contains some ALUMINA.

subject: chests
text: Ascending the upper right ladder with Float active and moving clockwise reveals three chests with a Dragon Egg, Hi Magic, and Ex Bomb.

evidence.quote: Go back down the steps, cast Float, and walk to the ladder in the upper right.  Walk around clockwise to open the three chests which contain a DRAGON EGG, HI MAGIC, and EX BOMB.

subject: chests
text: A ladder and hall to the upper right on the lower level leads to two chests with an Escape and Magic Guard.

evidence.quote: Head up and right to a ladder and into a hall which will lead to two chests which contain an ESCAPE and MAGIC GUARD.

subject: chests
text: The right door below leads upstairs to two chests containing an Ex Magic and Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the right door first and climb the stairs to two chests which contain an EX MAGIC and EX POTION.

subject: chest
text: The left door below leads to a chest containing a Revive.

evidence.quote: Then, take the left door to a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: switch
text: Flipping the switch in the center room redirects the warp point in the left room to a chest with an Ex Potion and steps to the next floor.

evidence.quote: Flip the switch in the center room, which will change the destination of the warp point in the left room to a chest which contains an EX POTION, and left to the steps to the next floor.

subject: chest
text: A chest to the left of the steps contains an Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: Open the chest to the left which contains an EX ARROWS.

subject: chest
text: Walking right and up from the steps leads to a chest containing a Revive.

evidence.quote: From the steps, walk right and up to a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: chest
text: In the lower right corner, entering the room leads to a chest containing an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Head down to the lower right corner and enter the room with a chest which contains an EX POTION.

subject: chest
text: Taking the warp point inside the lower right room leads to a chest containing a Silver Sword.

evidence.quote: Take the warp point to a chest which contains a SILVER SWORD.

subject: chest
text: Above the room outside the warp, a chest contains an Opal Ring.

evidence.quote: Return back outside the room and open the chest above which contains an OPAL RING.

subject: chest
text: After climbing down two ladders on the next floor, walking right leads to a chest with a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Climb down two ladders, then head right to a chest which contains a POWER GOURD.

subject: chest
text: Going down the ladder below and heading right leads to a chest containing a Mind Gourd.

evidence.quote: Go down the ladder below you, then continue right to a chest which contains a MIND GOURD.

subject: chest
text: Going down the last ladder to the left leads to a chest containing a Revive.

evidence.quote: Return left, then down the last ladder to a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: Clack
text: After talking with Clack at the fork and attempting to leave, he gives the player the Wave Ring.

evidence.quote: Finally, walk right to a fork, then up to meet Clack, who will tell you where Brant is.  After talking for awhile, attempt to leave, and he will give you the WAVE RING (ATP+30, DFP+22, INT+15, AGL+5, MGR+15, equip on Hero).

subject: chest
text: In the Cave to Marse east of the Tower of Light, a hallway contains a chest on the right with a Power Potion.

evidence.quote: East of the Tower of Light, cross the northern bridge to the Cave to Marse.  It's simply a hallway with a chest on the right which contains a POWER POTION.

subject: Demon Mace
text: Demon Mace can cast Blizzard, so they should be taken out quickly.

evidence.quote: Of the new enemies, Demon Mace can cast Blizzard, so take them out quickly.

subject: Red Core
text: Jerin should cast Confuse on Red Cores to keep them from running away.

evidence.quote: Red Cores are like the Mimickers, except with more HP and experience to gain, so have Jerin constantly cast Confuse against them to keep them from running away.

subject: chest
text: Heading up and climbing down a ladder, then up the next, leads to a chest containing an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Head up, climb down a ladder, then up the next to a chest which contains an EX POTION.

subject: chest
text: Climbing down the ladder to the right leads to a chest containing a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: Go down the ladder to the right to a chest which contains a GREAT POTION.

subject: swamp

evidence.quote: Walk left three steps, then down into the swamp to find a hidden MIND POTION.

text: Climbing the left ladder across the bridge leads to two chests containing a Revive and Power Potion.

evidence.quote: Continue up around the plateaus, across the bridge, and climb the left ladder to two more chests which contain a REVIVE and POWER POTION.

text: Past the fork and down a ladder, a chest contains a Hi Bomb.

evidence.quote: Continue right past a fork and down a ladder to a chest which contains a HI BOMB.

subject: chest
text: Inside the upper right room, a chest contains a piece of Alumina.

evidence.quote: Enter the upper right room to find a chest which contains another piece of ALUMINA.

subject: chest
text: Climbing down a ladder from the fork leads to a visible chest on the left containing a Power Potion.

evidence.quote: Go back to the fork, and climb down a ladder to a chest you can see to the left which contains a POWER POTION.

subject: chest
text: To the right of the ladder, a chest contains a Gloom Arrow.

evidence.quote: To the right of the ladder, you will find a chest which contains a GLOOM ARROW.

subject: chest
text: Ascending the nearby ladder and heading down and left leads to a chest with a Revive.

evidence.quote: Climb the nearby ladder, go down a little, then head left to a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: chest
text: Climbing the ladder to the right and down leads to a chest containing a Mach Ring.

evidence.quote: Walk right and down, then climb the ladder to a chest which contains a MACH RING (DFP+4, AGL+11, sell).

subject: chest
text: Walking around to the lower right corner leads to a chest containing a Hi Magic.

evidence.quote: Go back down the ladder, then walk around to the lower right corner to a chest which contains a HI MAGIC.

subject: chest
text: Climbing the ladder and heading left leads to the final chest on the floor containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Finally, climb the ladder, and head left to the last chest on this floor which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: chests
text: Heading left past the fork on the next plateau yields two chests containing a Foul Water and Gloom Arrow.

evidence.quote: On this plateau, head left past the fork, picking up two chests which contains a FOUL WATER and GLOOM ARROW.

subject: chest
text: Crossing a bridge straight down leads to a chest containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Go straight down across a bridge to a chest which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: chest
text: Returning across the bridge and walking right leads to a chest containing a Power Potion.

evidence.quote: Return across the bridge and walk right to a chest which contains a POWER POTION.

subject: chests
text: Continuing right along the path yields four chests containing 1000 Gold, a Spell Potion, a Gloom Arrow, and an Escape.

evidence.quote: Continue right along the path with four chests which contains 1000 GOLD, a SPELL POTIION (use on Hero), GLOOM ARROW, and ESCAPE.

subject: chest
text: On the lower level, heading left from the fork leads to a chest containing a Hi Bomb.

evidence.quote: Walk up to the fork and left to a chest which contains a HI BOMB.

subject: chest
text: Heading up from the fork on the lower level leads to a chest containing a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: Head up from the fork to a chest which contains a GREAT POTION.

text: The room to the left contains two chests with a Hi Magic and Ex Magic.

evidence.quote: To the left is a room with two chests which contain a HI MAGIC and EX MAGIC.

subject: chest
text: The lower left room contains a chest with an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Leave the room, go left, and down to the lower left room with a chest which contains an EX POTION.

subject: chest
text: Heading right and up leads to a chest containing a Revive.

evidence.quote: Go right and up to a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: chest

evidence.quote: Step left two, down three, and right to open it which contains a HI BOMB.  Then, step up to fall to the last room.

subject: chests
text: In the final room, two chests contain a Float and Sweet Water.

evidence.quote: Open the two chests you see which contain a FLOAT and SWEET WATER.

subject: swamp
text: Walking up into the swamp from the left side of the left chest reveals a hidden Ex Magic.

evidence.quote: From the left side of the left chest, walk up into the swamp to find a hidden EX MAGIC.

subject: chest
text: The chest containing a Revive in the upper right room must be opened before speaking to Brant, or it permanently transforms into an exit warp point.

evidence.quote: Before talking to the man to the left, enter the upper right room to find a chest which contains a REVIVE.  If you don't get that now, the chest will become an exit warp point later.

subject: Brant
text: Talking to Brant in the upper left corner of the room causes Jerin to cast Escape and awards a piece of Alumina.

evidence.quote: Now, talk to the man in the upper left corner of the room who is Brant.  Jerin will automatically cast Escape and you will receive another piece of ALUMINA.
